name: MOW_WORKOBJ_CANDOBJ_RELS
description: Table for storing the Work Object and Candidate Object relationship

columns.name: WORKOBJ_CANDOBJ_REL_GUID
columns.description: Primary Key to uniquely identify the row

columns.name: NO_MATCH_BEHAVIOR
columns.description: This field indicates the disposition behaviour, when there is no match(Remove,Retain or Error)

columns.name: REF_ROW_GUID
columns.description: Reference key the to respective N/D row.

columns.name: RECORD_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates if WO-CO Relation has been published to Engine

columns.name: WORK_OBJECT_GUID
columns.description: Foreign Key to the MOW_ASGN_OBJECTS_B table

columns.name: CANDIDATE_OBJECT_GUID
columns.description: Foreign Key to the MOW_ASGN_OBJECTS_B table

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_MODE
columns.description: This filed indicate to evaluate TBA/RBA, based on the assignment mode (Territory, Matching, Scoring or Classification)

columns.name: CAND_PARENT_ATTR
columns.description: This is used in TBA to know the parent attribute name.

columns.name: CAND_ATTR1
columns.description: Contains the first/only attribute name in the composite primary key to write back the single candidate on the Work Object VO

columns.name: CAND_ATTR2
columns.description: Contains the second attribute name in the composite primary key to write back the single candidate on the Work Object VO

columns.name: CAND_ATTR3
columns.description: Contains the third attribute name in the composite primary key to write back the single candidate on the Work Object VO

columns.name: CAND_SCORE_ATTR
columns.description: Contains the column name on the base VO for storing the score of the candidate assigned

columns.name: CAND_TEAM_VO_NAME
columns.description: The VO name which will be the intersection for writing the candidates

columns.name: CAND_TEAM_CAND_ATTR1
columns.description: Contains the first/only attribute name to write back the assigned candidate on the child/intersection VO

columns.name: CAND_TEAM_CAND_ATTR2
columns.description: Contains the second attribute name to write back the assigned candidate on the child/intersection VO

columns.name: CAND_TEAM_CAND_ATTR3
columns.description: Contains the third attribute name to write back the assigned candidate on the child/intersection VO

columns.name: CAND_TEAM_SCORE_ATTR
columns.description: Contains the column name on the child/team VO for storing the score of the candidate assigned

columns.name: CAND_TEAM_MANL_ATTR
columns.description: Contains the candidate manual attribute name on the child/intersection VO

columns.name: CAND_TEAM_SYS_ATTR
columns.description: Contains the candidate system attribute name on the child/intersection VO

columns.name: ADD_CAND_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to write back the assigned candidates and rules

columns.name: INVOKE_CALLBACK_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to call the call back function on the invoked work object

columns.name: CAND_REPLACE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to delete the existing candidates if they no longer qualify

columns.name: KEEP_MANL_ASGN_CAND_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to delete the user assigned candidates from the team

columns.name: CAND_EXCL_VO_NAME
columns.description: Contains the intersection VO name for the candidate exclusion list.

columns.name: CAND_EXCL_ATTR1
columns.description: Contains the attribute name of the first candidate primary key field on the candidate exclusion intersection VO.

columns.name: CAND_EXCL_ATTR2
columns.description: Contains the attribute name of the second candidate primary key field on the candidate exclusion intersection VO.

columns.name: CAND_EXCL_ATTR3
columns.description: Contains the attribute name of the third candidate primary key field on the candidate exclusion intersection VO.

columns.name: CAND_EXCL_COV_ATTR
columns.description: Used in TBA to Identify the attribute on the candidate object that stores the exclusion coverage indicator.

columns.name: CAND_DISCRIM_ATTR
columns.description: This is used in TBA to know the candidate discriminator attribute name.

columns.name: EXCL_ASGN_ATTR
columns.description: Contains the name of the lock assignment attribute name in the primary VO, which is the attribute in the work object's VO that can be used to prevent assigning the certain row. This is applicable only for the Work Object

columns.name: ASGN_DATE_ATTR
columns.description: Contains the attribute name on the base VO for datetime to be stamped when the record is last assigned

columns.name: MAX_NO_OF_CANDIDATES
columns.description: Maximum number of Candidates to be returned upon a Assignment request

columns.name: MERGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether assignment should merge the results from evaluation of each mapping set before submitting to disposition.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
